entities.name: SOR transparent container
entities.description: An information element that can be provided during registration procedures, containing steering of roaming information with integrity protection.

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: A container IE used in NAS transport procedures that can carry various payload types including SOR transparent container and UE parameters update transparent container.

entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: An IE that indicates the type of content in the payload container, such as SOR transparent container or UE parameters update transparent container.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: A NAS message sent by the network during registration procedure that can contain the SOR transparent container IE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION COMPLETE
entities.description: A NAS message sent by the UE during registration procedure that can contain the SOR transparent container IE.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: A downlink NAS transport message used in network-initiated NAS transport procedure that can carry the Payload container IE.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: An uplink NAS transport message used in UE-initiated NAS transport procedure that can carry the Payload container IE.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: The NAS procedure during which SOR transparent container IE can be exchanged between UE and network.

entities.name: Network-initiated NAS transport procedure
entities.description: A NAS procedure where the network sends payload container to UE in DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: UE-initiated NAS transport procedure
entities.description: A NAS procedure where the UE sends payload container to network in UL NAS TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: SOR or UPU container type condition
entities.description: Condition where payload container type is set to SOR transparent container or UE parameters update transparent container.

entities.name: Integrity protection by HPLMN/SNPN
entities.description: Property indicating that the IE is integrity protected by the HPLMN or subscribed SNPN as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501.

entities.name: MAC generation by UE
entities.description: Property indicating that the SoR-MAC-IUE or UPU-MAC-IUE is generated by the UE as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501.

relations.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message can contain the SOR transparent container IE.
REGISTRATION COMPLETE message can contain the SOR transparent container IE.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message contains the Payload container IE.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains the Payload container IE.
Payload container IE includes the Payload container type IE.
Payload container type IE guards the integrity protection requirements based on its value.
When payload container type is SOR or UPU container, the IE is integrity protected by HPLMN/SNPN.
When payload container type is SOR or UPU container, the UE generates MAC for integrity protection.
SOR transparent container IE requires integrity protection by HPLMN/SNPN.
SOR transparent container IE requires MAC generation by UE for integrity.
Registration procedure includes sending REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
Registration procedure includes sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
Network-initiated NAS transport procedure includes sending DL NAS TRANSPORT message.
UE-initiated NAS transport procedure includes sending UL NAS TRANSPORT message.
